name: EmailAccountFinder
description: EmailAccountFinder is an OSINT web platform checking email registrations across 120+ platforms via password recovery APIs without alerting targets. Features live Python API, Web Simulation, metadata extraction & CSV/JSON exports. Developed by Aakash Sakhalkar (powered by megadose/holehe).

paragraphs: EmailAccountFinder is an enterprise-grade web application and OSINT email intelligence platform that allows security researchers and investigators to check if a target email address is registered across 120+ platforms (such as Twitter, Instagram, GitHub, Imgur, Discord, Adobe, Amazon, Spotify, and more) using password recovery and registration API signatures without notifying the target email.
🌐 Live Web Application: 🐍 Live Render API Backend: 👨‍💻 Developer Portfolio: ⭐ Engine GitHub Repository:
features: Live Python API (Default): Sends real-time queries through the backend server running the official holehe Python framework.
Web Simulation Mode: Standalone browser engine for offline testing and rapid UI demonstrations.
Automatically extracts partially obfuscated recovery emails (e.g., exe@gmail.com) and phone number hints (e.g., +1 78).
